notes.title: Community Items - Trading Cards & Points Shop Items
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910577/dacaf7754511ed3955ca8aa6593872e07d58adce.jpg[/img]

Thanks to your support, we were able to add trading cards and other items! 

Part of the trading cards you can get by playing the game, emotions and profile backgrounds, you can get by collecting a badge, or by buying in the Points Shop.

Our team hope you enjoy these items so we can add more in the future!

We also added a gallery and fixed typos and bugs.

notes.title: Lovely Overseer is out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910577/15351308b6aa44fe6f5c411195cb5ba601d3fc85.jpg[/img]

We have worked hard on our game and we really hope that you will like it!

The basic version of the game contains a romantic, sometimes dramatic story with a touch of censorship.

If you like hot scenes and additional animated images - welcome to the free DLC!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321550/Lovely_Overseer__18_Adult_Only_Content/


P.S. We tested the game with beta testers who supported us on kickstarter - unfortunately, even with such testing, we could have missed something. If you find a bug, typo, or difficulties with passing the endings, please write to us on the steam game forum.

notes.title: Release Date!
notes.notes:
We'll have a 10% discount on release, so don't forget to hit that 'wishlist' button!

Also, all buyers of the base game will have access to free DLC - without censorship!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321550/Lovely_Overseer__18_Adult_Only_Content/

notes.title: A new minor character - Kira
notes.notes:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/031/643/683/6f482a1209e8616487b951230bf3bcfd_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1607082229&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=873f3b9648cb0888db191ff8ba2478e2[/img]

Hello, everyone!

Our artist has almost finished working on the new character Kira.  The animated version is also almost ready. 

Species: White Tiger

Personality

Cold and stoic at first but can be quite passionate and excitable once you earn her trust. Spent her entire life in the cold, hostile and wintry lands of the North with very few people to rely on.

We hope you enjoyed the new character!
